tool_schemas.name: xano_list_instances
tool_schemas.description: Lists Xano instances known to this MCP server, optionally filtered by status, and returns a paged result set using limit and cursor (provide the returned cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if status, limit, or cursor are invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to enumerate instances. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if listing is rate-limited or exceeds configured usage limits.

limit.description: Maximum number of instances to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: xano_get_instance_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns full metadata for a single Xano instance identified by instance_name. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_name is missing or malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access instance metadata, and NOT_FOUND if no instance with that name exists in the local representation. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if requests for instance metadata exceed configured limits.

instance_name.description: The Xano instance name/slug (e.g., "xnwv-v1z6-dvnr").

tool_schemas.name: xano_list_databases
tool_schemas.description: Lists workspaces/databases within the given instance, optionally filtered by status, and returns a paged result set using limit and cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_name, status, limit, or cursor are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read workspaces for the instance, and NOT_FOUND if the instance does not exist. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if listing workspaces exceeds configured usage limits.

instance_name.description: The Xano instance name/slug (e.g., "xnwv-v1z6-dvnr").

limit.description: Maximum number of workspaces to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: xano_get_workspace_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata for a single workspace/database in an instance, addressed by workspace_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_name or workspace_id are missing or not numeric (when provided as a string), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the workspace, and NOT_FOUND if the instance or workspace is unknown. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if workspace detail lookups exceed configured limits.

instance_name.description: The Xano instance name/slug (e.g., "xnwv-v1z6-dvnr").

oneOf.description: The Xano numeric workspace/database id.
The Xano numeric workspace/database id encoded as a string.

workspace_id.description: The workspace/database id (string or number).

tool_schemas.name: xano_list_tables
tool_schemas.description: Lists tables within the specified workspace/database and returns a paged result set using limit and cursor, optionally filtered by table status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_name, database_id, status, limit, or cursor are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read schema for the workspace, and NOT_FOUND if the instance or workspace/database does not exist. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if table listing exceeds configured usage limits.

instance_name.description: The Xano instance name/slug (e.g., "xnwv-v1z6-dvnr").

oneOf.description: The Xano numeric workspace/database id.
The Xano numeric workspace/database id encoded as a string.

database_id.description: The Xano workspace/database id (string or number).

limit.description: Maximum number of tables to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: xano_get_table_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata for a specific table within a workspace, including its stored schema-related details when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_name, workspace_id, or table_id are missing or not numeric (when provided as strings), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access table metadata, and NOT_FOUND if the instance, workspace, or table is unknown. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if table detail lookups exceed configured limits.

instance_name.description: The Xano instance name/slug (e.g., "xnwv-v1z6-dvnr").

oneOf.description: The Xano numeric table id.
The Xano numeric table id encoded as a string.

table_id.description: The table id (string or number).

tool_schemas.name: xano_create_table
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new table in the specified workspace and returns the created table record, including its assigned identifiers and stored properties (name/description/docs/auth/tags). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, name is empty, or optional fields are of the wrong type, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot modify tables in the workspace, and NOT_FOUND if the instance or workspace does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if a table with the same name already exists in that workspace, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if table creation exceeds configured limits.

instance_name.description: The Xano instance name/slug (e.g., "xnwv-v1z6-dvnr").

oneOf.description: The Xano numeric workspace/database id.
The Xano numeric workspace/database id encoded as a string.

workspace_id.description: The workspace/database id (string or number).

docs.description: Documentation text for the new table.

auth.description: Whether authentication is required for the table.

tag.description: List of tags to assign to the new table.

tool_schemas.name: xano_update_table
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing table’s mutable properties (name, description, docs, auth, tags) and returns the updated table record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if identifiers are invalid or provided fields fail validation (for example, empty name), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot modify tables in the workspace, and NOT_FOUND if the instance, workspace, or table does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the update would duplicate another table’s name in the same workspace, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if update operations exceed configured limits.

table_id.description: The id of the table to update (string or number).

docs.description: New documentation text for the table.

auth.description: New authentication requirement setting for the table.

tag.description: New list of tags for the table.

tool_schemas.name: xano_delete_table
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a table from the specified workspace and returns the deletion result for that table. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_name/workspace_id/table_id are missing or malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot delete tables, and NOT_FOUND if the instance, workspace, or table does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the table cannot be deleted due to its current state (for example, already deleting/deleted), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if delete operations exceed configured limits.

tool_schemas.description: Creates a btree index on the specified table using the provided ordered `fields` (each with `name` and `op`) and returns the created index definition (and/or updated index list). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `fields` is empty, contains unknown field names, or includes invalid sort operations, NOT_FOUND if the instance/workspace/table does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you cannot modify indexes. tool_schemas.name: xano_delete_file
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a single file artifact from the specified workspace and returns the deleted file metadata (or a deletion confirmation) for that file_id. tool_schemas.name: xano_disable_instance
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a Xano instance from status='active' to status='disabled' in the local representation. Returns the updated instance record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_name is missing/malformed, NOT_FOUND if no active instance matches, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot manage instances, and CONFLICT if the instance is already disabled or deleted.

instance_name.description: The Xano instance name/slug (e.g., "xnwv-v1z6-dvnr").

tool_schemas.implementation:
def xano_disable_instance(instance_name, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, uuid, re
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0523000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0523000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "xano_disable_instance"

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, message=None, **meta):
        logs = _load("xano_request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list): logs = []
        logs.append({
            "id": "req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "instance_name": instance_name,
            "workspace_id": None,
            "status": status,
            "message": message,
            "timestamp": _now(),
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "meta": meta or {}
        })
        _save("xano_request_logs.json", logs)

    if not isinstance(instance_name, str) or not instance_name.strip():
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "instance_name must be a non-empty string")
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], code=e["error"]["code"])
        return e
    # mild slug check
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-]{2,127}", instance_name.strip()):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "instance_name is malformed")
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], code=e["error"]["code"])
        return e

    instances = _load("xano_instances.json")
    if not isinstance(instances, list):
        instances = []

    matches = [r for r in instances if r.get("instance_name") == instance_name]
    active = [r for r in matches if r.get("status") == "active"]
    if len(active) != 1:
        if any(r.get("status") == "disabled" for r in matches):
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "Instance is already disabled")
            _log("error", e["error"]["message"], code=e["error"]["code"])
            return e
        if any(r.get("status") == "deleted" for r in matches):
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "Instance is deleted")
            _log("error", e["error"]["message"], code=e["error"]["code"])
            return e
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "No active instance matches instance_name")
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], code=e["error"]["code"])
        return e

    inst = active[0]
    # lifecycle transition: active -> disabled allowed
    inst["status"] = "disabled"
    inst["updated_at"] = _now()

    updated = False
    for i, r in enumerate(instances):
        if r.get("id") == inst.get("id"):
            instances[i] = inst
            updated = True
            break
    if not updated:
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Instance not found")
        _log("error", e["error"]["message"], code=e["error"]["code"])
        return e

    _save("xano_instances.json", instances)
    _log("ok")
    return {"instance": inst}
